entries: Unadapted borrowing from English Columbo, surname of a famous TV detective portrayed in the series of the same name.
senses: Sherlock; used to refer to someone who expresses the obvious while not being aware of its obviousness

entries: Back-formation from einstreuen, by surface analysis, ein- + Streu.

entries: Haplology of earlier Narzissismus. Coined by Sigmund Freud from Narziss (“character in Greek mythology who became obsessed with his own reflection”) + -ismus.
